description: File a dispute on a goods order (order_id; reasons: not_as_described, defective, not_received, fraud_unauthorized_charge, duplicate_charge, other) or a service quote (service_quote_id; reasons: service_not_delivered, service_quality, service_scope_mismatch, plus the generic three). Exactly one target. Filing on a service quote pauses its payout auto-release. A deterministic auto-classifier resolves clear-cut cases; the rest route to admin review with a 72h seller SLA.

claimed_amount_pence.description: Amount claimed, in pence (minor units); cannot exceed the charged total. Omit if unsure.

desired_outcome.description: What the buyer wants, e.g. a full refund. Max 500 chars.

order_id.description: UUID of the goods order in dispute. Provide exactly one of order_id / service_quote_id.

reason.description: Dispute reason. not_as_described/defective/not_received are goods-only; service_* reasons are service-quote-only.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the service quote in dispute. Provide exactly one of order_id / service_quote_id.

summary.description: Plain-text account of the problem, max 4000 chars.

name: disputes_file
title: Disputes file
